deviations.what: The sample ships its own style.css - the list styling both FlexBoxes rely on (paddings, the 25% items, the hover transition). abap2UI5 serves no per-sample stylesheet, so the rules are injected verbatim through one extra core:HTML <style> leaf at the top of the view (structural-diff reports control extra core:HTML: 6 vs 7 - the six anchor leaves are the original's own). Nothing else changes.
